backlog.title: pi-mulligan refinements (cancel-by-target · operator echo · checkpoint expiry · nudge text)
backlog.description: MEDIUM delta: four independent, spec-already-written refinements to existing tools/nudges, plus a README sync. No new architecture — every change is a localized modification to code that already exists. The spec is the source of truth and is already at the target state; the code lags it in four spots. Milestones M1–M4 touch disjoint files and may be parallelized; M5 (README) depends on all of M1–M4.

milestones.title: mulligan_cancel target-based API (headline change)
milestones.description: Rewrite mulligan_cancel to identify the marker by `target` (same hint shape as mulligan_shrink: by_tool_call_id / by_tool_name+occurrence / by_content_includes), with explicit markerId as optional fallback. LIFO: most-recent active marker covering the matched message is retired. Filter side unchanged (drops by uuid data.id).

tasks.title: Rewrite mulligan_cancel (schema + execute + description + tests)
tasks.description: Replace the id-only CancelParams with a target-union + optional markerId. Rewrite cancelExecute's step 3 to resolve the target hint → matched message → covering marker → marker uuid. Update CANCEL_DESC. Add comprehensive target-based tests.

subtasks.title: CancelParams schema + CANCEL_DESC
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/005_95d30743cdd4/architecture/m1_cancel_target_resolution.md for the full target-resolution design. The current cancel.ts has CancelParams = Type.Object({ markerId: Type.String(...) }) (id-only). The new schema adds a `target` union structurally identical to ShrinkParams.target in shrink.ts (verified: same 3-arm union — by_tool_call_id / by_tool_name+occurrence / by_content_includes).
2. INPUT: The current src/tools/cancel.ts file. ShrinkParams.target in src/tools/shrink.ts (lines ~62-76) as the reference shape to mirror. spec/05 §5 Parameter schema (verbatim in the PRD).
3. LOGIC: Replace `CancelParams = Type.Object({ markerId: Type.String({...}) })` with the target-union + optional markerId (spec/05 §5 verbatim). The exact schema is: `target: Type.Union([{by_tool_call_id}, {by_tool_name + occurrence}, {by_content_includes}], { description: 'How to identify the marker to cancel — the SAME hint shape mulligan_shrink uses. Resolved live each turn (robust to compaction). The most recent active marker (shrink or rewind) whose target/span covers the matched message is retired.' })` + `markerId: Type.Optional(Type.String({ description: 'Optional explicit fallback: the markerId returned by mulligan_rewind/mulligan_shrink in details.markerId. If both target and markerId are given, markerId wins.' }))`. Object-level description: 'Cancel accepts a `target` (preferred) or an explicit `markerId` (fallback). At least one MUST be present.' Update CANCEL_DESC to the new wording: identify by `target` — same hint shape as mulligan_shrink; most recent marker affecting that content is retired; or explicit `markerId`. Keep CancelDetails/refusal()/readOwn/isRecord helpers unchanged.
4. OUTPUT: Exported `CancelParams` (typebox schema) with the target-union + optional markerId. Updated `CANCEL_DESC` string. Type `CancelArgs = Static<typeof CancelParams>`.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] The CANCEL_DESC string IS the LLM-facing doc — it is updated IN this subtask. No separate doc file.

subtasks.title: cancelExecute target resolution
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/005_95d30743cdd4/architecture/m1_cancel_target_resolution.md for the verified reuse paths and covering logic. Key APIs verified: resolveShrinkTarget (transforms.ts:758, EXPORTED, pure) resolves a target hint → message index. sessionEntryToContextMessages (from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) maps SessionEntry → AgentMessage[]. buildContextEntries() on ctx.sessionManager produces the compaction-aware snapshot. LabelEntry has { type:'label', targetId:string, label:string|undefined }.
2. INPUT: The new CancelParams schema from P1.M1.T1.S1 (target union + optional markerId). The current cancel.ts execute body (steps 1-7). resolveShrinkTarget and MessageLike/ShrinkTarget from transforms.ts (imported). sessionEntryToContextMessages from the pi package.
3. LOGIC: Rewrite step 3 to resolve the marker to retire preferred-by-target then fallback-by-markerId (spec/05 §5 Behavior):
   - TARGET PATH: Build a message snapshot via ctx.sessionManager.buildContextEntries().flatMap(sessionEntryToContextMessages) (mirror shrink.ts:resolveTargetEntryId's 2-liner — DO NOT extract a shared helper, just inline it). Resolve params.target against the snapshot using resolveShrinkTarget(messages, target) → matched message index. Then collect candidate markers — every ACTIVE mulligan:rewind/mulligan:shrink whose effect COVERS the matched message: a shrink covers the message its OWN target resolves to (resolve each shrink's target via readOwn(marker, 'target') → resolveShrinkTarget → same index); a rewind covers any message in its hidden span (read hideEntryIds via readOwn, map the matched message index → its entry id via a local entryIdAtMessageIndex helper, check membership). Pick the MOST RECENT candidate by seq (LIFO — highest seq wins). Read its uuid data.id via readOwn.
   - MARKERID FALLBACK: if params.markerId is set (or target matched nothing and markerId present), scan for entry.id === markerId ∧ customType ∈ {rewind,shrink} → read data.id. IF BOTH GIVEN, markerId WINS.
   - Keep steps 4 (not-found no-op: return 'Mulligan: no active marker found for that target — nothing to cancel.' + details:{cancelled:false}), 5 (already-cancelled idempotency), 6 (persist uuid as targetId via appendCancelMarker), 7 (return) AS-IS — they operate on the uuid.
   - Add a local entryIdAtMessageIndex(entries, index) helper (~15 lines: cursor-walk entries with sessionEntryToContextMessages(e).length, mirror shrink.ts's private helper). Wrap new resolution in the existing outer try/catch (E13). A malformed/unreadable marker → not-found no-op.
   - MOCKING: ctx.sessionManager.buildContextEntries() and getEntries() are faked via makeCtx (session entries scripted per test). No external services.
4. OUTPUT: cancelExecute resolves target/markerId → uuid targetUuid, then steps 4-7 proceed as before (unchanged). The cancel marker's targetId is the uuid data.id (NOT the entry id).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] No user-facing doc change beyond CANCEL_DESC (updated in S1). The behavior JSDoc on cancelExecute should be updated to describe the new target resolution path.

subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/005_95d30743cdd4/architecture/m2_shrink_operator_echo.md for verified Pi API surfaces. ctx.ui.notify(message: string, type?: 'info'|'warning'|'error'): void — confirmed in ExtensionUIContext (types.d.ts:76). ctx.hasUI: boolean — confirmed (types.d.ts:215), true in TUI and RPC modes. 2. INPUT: The config.shrink.notifyMaxChars from P1.M2.T1.S1. The current src/tools/shrink.ts execute body.

milestones.title: Checkpoint auto-expiry on consumption
milestones.description: A checkpoint is auto-retired on consumption: once a mulligan_rewind(granularity:'checkpoint') successfully targets it, the checkpoint is consumed (no longer active in mulligan_audit; a second rewind to the same name refuses unless re-created).

tasks.title: Retire a checkpoint when a rewind targets it
tasks.description: Add a consumption hook in rewind.ts: after a successful checkpoint-granularity rewind persist, clear the checkpoint label via pi.setLabel(targetId, undefined). Then audit.ts's checkpoint listing naturally drops it.

subtasks.title: Checkpoint consumption hook in rewind.ts
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/005_95d30743cdd4/architecture/m3_checkpoint_expiry.md for the verified LabelEntry structure and consumption hook design. Key findings: LabelEntry has { type:'label', targetId:string, label:string|undefined } — calling pi.setLabel(targetId, undefined) clears the label. listCheckpoints (audit.ts:324) scans for label.startsWith('mulligan:checkpoint:') → clearing makes it disappear. checkpointExists (rewind.ts:293) checks the same → second rewind to consumed name refuses 'not found'. pi is available in rewindExecute via the makeRewindTool(pi) factory closure. The persist step is at rewind.ts ~line 547 (step 7); the success return is at ~line 560 (step 9).
2. INPUT: The current src/tools/rewind.ts execute body (checkpoint-granularity path: step 3 checkpointExists check ~line 462; step 7 persist ~line 547; step 9 return ~line 560). pi is captured via the factory closure.
3. LOGIC: After the successful persist (step 7, ~line 547) and BEFORE the return (step 9), ONLY on the `granularity === 'checkpoint'` success path, add a consumption hook:
   - Scan ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() for a LabelEntry where label === `mulligan:checkpoint:${params.checkpoint}`.
   - Read its targetId via readOwn.
   - Call pi.setLabel(targetId, undefined) to clear the label.
   - Wrap in try/catch (E13 — a label-clear failure must never undo the rewind; the rewind marker is already persisted).
   - Use the existing readOwn helper in rewind.ts (if rewind.ts doesn't have one, it has checkpointExists which reads entries defensively — follow the same defensive pattern).
   - After clearing, audit.ts:listCheckpoints naturally drops it (label is no longer a string starting with the prefix), and checkpointExists returns false on the next rewind attempt (label gone → 'not found' refusal).
   MOCKING: In tests, makePi must capture setLabel calls; makeCtx scripts getEntries() to include LabelEntry fixtures.
4. OUTPUT: A consumed checkpoint no longer appears in mulligan_audit; a second rewind to it refuses 'not found'; re-creating (mulligan_checkpoint again) sets a fresh label and works.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Add an inline comment at the consumption hook citing spec/05 §3 step 5 ('Auto-expiry on consumption'). No separate doc file.
